figure: Figure 6.2 — Request-latency distribution: the mean looks healthy and the p95 SLO is met
issue: The red annotation box that labels the sample-p99 vertical line is overlapped by the white legend box, so the on-chart label is truncated to 'sample p9' with the final '9' hidden behind the legend. A reader looking only at the plot cannot confirm the label reads 'sample p99'; the full value is recoverable only from the legend text and the body on p.96, which defeats the purpose of the in-plot label.
evidence: On the rendered page the red box sitting above the red dash-dot line at x≈1.33 s displays 'sample p9'; its right border and trailing character are covered by the white legend box ('mean = 0.85s / sample p99 (interpolation) = 1.33s / population p99 = 5.0 s / SLO 2 s (TTFT budget)'). The two boxes occupy the same top horizontal band of the plot, so the legend is drawn on top of the red label.
acceptance_test: Reposition the legend box (or the red label) so the complete string 'sample p99' is visible with no glyph covered; re-render at 150 dpi and confirm (a) the red box's right border and all characters are unobscured, (b) the red dash-dot line at 1.33 s is still unambiguously associated with its label, and (c) the green p50/p90/p95 boxes and the 'SLO 2 s (TTFT budget)' box remain legible and non-overlapping.
